title_sq: Tek 5 Maji, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Ne Ndertim Te Ri, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Tek 5 Maji, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Ne Ndertim Te Ri, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te fundit te nje pallati te ri ne ndertim e siper dhe ka siperfaqe bruto 108.7 m2 nga te cilat 92 m2 neto. Organizohet nga korrridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 1 ballkon. Kompleksi ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per cilesine e larte te punimeve. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: On May 5, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale in New Building, with Regular Floor Plan!!!
description_en: On May 5, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale in New Building, with Regular Floor Plan!!! The apartment is located on the last 8th floor of a new building under construction and has a gross area of ​​108.7 m2, of which 92 m2 is net. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room together with kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 2 toilets and 1 balcony. The complex in which the apartment is located stands out for the high quality of the works. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
